WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
    AND w.status IN ('delivered', 'collected') AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN net_amount END) / sum(net_amount), 2) AS cc_share_net_pct,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN gross_amount END) / sum(gross_amount), 2) AS cc_share_gross_pct,
  round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN receipt_id END) / count(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS cc_share_orders_pct,
  sum(net_amount) total_net
FROM web_lines GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'both', null,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN net_amount END) / sum(net_amount), 2), null, null, sum(net_amount)
FROM web_lines
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount - coalesce(r.rn,0) AS net_after
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10))
SELECT fiscal_period, round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_after END)/sum(net_after),2) FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
